class.name: NNConsiderationGroup
class.brief_description: Aggregates the input from several considerations or consideration groups to create more complex consideration logic.
class.description: Consideration groups can be used to aggregate the input from several considerations or consideration groups to create more complex consideration logic. You can nest as many consideration groups as you like, and each consideration group may contain any number and combination of child consideration groups or child considerations.

members.member: How the child considerations and consideration groups are aggregated into the group's score. The default is [constant NoodleNodes.EVALUATION_MULTIPLY].
If [code]true[/code], inverts the aggregated [member NNConsiderations.score] as [code]1.0 - score[/code] after all enabled child considerations have been evaluated.
